theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (2 * i + 1) = (n + 1) ^ 2 := by
  induction n with d hd
  case zero =>
    simp [Finset.range, Finset.sum]
  case succ d =>
    have : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), (2 * i + 1) = (d + 1) ^ 2 := hd
    rw [Finset.range_eq_insert (Finset.range d) (d : ℕ)]
    simp only [Finset.sum_insert, Finset.sum_range_add_const, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    rw [Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm]
    rw [Nat.add_one, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm]
    congr' at hd
    rw [hd]
    ring
